decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at TJ-C590-09 (16.5 g/t). Radio and CMMS agree, so the rules allow a move. The likely repair is 13:20. LH-08 comes from a cheap development heading (DS-E569-01). It gains 48.1 oz and loses 1.6 oz at home, for a net of 46.5 oz, the best option. Only one loader is needed because the stockpile room is limited, and the check_decision dry run passed.
